_doc: Hand-authored river links (tiles), baked by tools/bake_river_links.py on top of rivers_baked.json. The first point is where the water comes from, the last where it flows to. {"snap": [x, y]} = the nearest node of an existing river (takes over its width).

links._note: The southern bend of the northern river feeds the head of the river that runs west to the coast; passes just west of the quest tile (776, 770).
Outflow of the Hexenwald lake (lakes.json ponds) north to the western river's corner.
